message:
You know, being prepared for a storm is a bit like packing for a family road trip: you want to have everything you might need, even if it means lugging around a few extra snacks. 🌪️ I came across a handy resource from the National Weather Service that covers flood safety, and I think it’s worth a peek. It’s like having a little guidebook in your back pocket when Mother Nature decides to throw a tantrum. 

Remember, it’s better to be the gloriously over-prepared person in the room than the one left scrambling for a flashlight when the lights go out! 

What’s your go-to tip for storm prep? I’d love to hear it!
